sv.title: Brittiska bilar kan bli ”Made in Europe”
sv.summary: EU-ländernas regeringar närmar sig en överenskommelse som skulle inkludera Storbritanniens bilindustri i ”Made in Europe”-strategin. Det skriver Financial Times, som tagit del av det senaste utkastet.

en.title: British cars could become ”Made in Europe”
en.summary: EU member state governments are nearing an agreement that would include the UK's car industry in the ”Made in Europe” strategy. This is reported by the Financial Times, which has seen the latest draft.
